domain_description: predictive maintenance — forecasting remaining useful life (RUL, in days) for heavy equipment from sensor telemetry
high_score_label: long remaining useful life (healthy, low near-term failure risk)
low_score_label: short remaining useful life (imminent failure risk)
factor_positive_label: factor extending predicted remaining useful life (lowers failure risk)
factor_negative_label: factor shortening predicted remaining useful life (raises failure risk)
outcome_label: mean actual remaining useful life (days) observed in holdout data
recommended_action_hint: Prioritise inspection or parts staging for assets with predicted RUL under ~7 days, especially where vibration or oil-pressure readings are the dominant driver.
